data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

My overall recommendation is **1Password if ease of use is the priority, and Bitwarden if value for money is the priority.**

A good team password manager should do more than store passwords. It should let you share credentials securely, control who can access them, and revoke access immediately when someone leaves.

## My top 4 choices

![Get to know 1Password for Mac | 1Password Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/C4U7UvvWr1lsit0fdwRMADZs7wYIji_AIA_d_hCeSHTTS1dPoJwwNeSzAPqWszRkpvDsM-p6I-6bznHJsD41eDQWYBj0MySy4qOfvgyzlD_4z3rPSGN9LVxo1hBQTb8qLml3yarSFkZEwcSqyJe7UAnBKtGHsXMSYuWNAwGS3UO1kE8Ogcbnaa14C9ioehoa?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall experience)

- Excellent, intuitive apps.
- Shared vaults with granular permissions.
- Security alerts and password health monitoring.
- Good for non-technical teams.

**Price\:** \$24.95/month for up to 10 users on Teams Starter Pack, billed annually. [1password.com](https://1password.com/pricing/business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[1password.com](https://1password.com/product/teams-small-business-password-manager?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[1Password pricing](https://1password.com/pricing/business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Free High-Quality Bitwarden Logo for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/p0IJzf2NCUQ2t02rqtPWDpe7Tx4YGCRNleASv1NjpztaDI--7OD-0zWJhdBi_4Wn4-v0Hr3hoS6JA2KXHdCOlvvdfHelZm6tTBmFuxgAbBftLkdqobRCpEkp4ysyI4Rm6vafJPMfHi8ri9Tdeng_QKXRw7C7a5ESA6hn8XLhRMLnvM7oFmwZESsO4_SFLJaX?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source password manager.
- Unlimited shared collections.
- Audit and event logs.
- Directory synchronisation and SCIM.
- Self-hosting option on Enterprise.

**Price\:** \$4/user/month for Teams, billed annually. [bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/en-gb/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[bitwarden.com](https://bitwarden.com/en-gb/help/password-manager-plans/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Bitwarden business pricing](https://bitwarden.com/en-gb/pricing/business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

Best for administration and security controls

- Shared team folders.
- Admin console and security audits.
- Policy enforcement.
- More advanced identity integrations on higher tiers.

**Price\:** Tier-dependent; offers a 5–10-seat starter plan. [www.keepersecurity.com](https://www.keepersecurity.com/en_GB/business.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.keepersecurity.com](https://www.keepersecurity.com/en_GB/pricing/business-and-enterprise.html?LSNSUBSITE=LSNSUBSITE&t=b&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/en_GB/business.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

Best for privacy-conscious teams

- End-to-end encrypted credentials.
- Secure sharing.
- Privacy-focused ecosystem.
- Worth considering if European data protection is a priority.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

## What I'd choose

| Your priority | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Easiest for everyone | 1Password |
| Best price/features | Bitwarden |
| Advanced admin controls | Keeper |
| Privacy-focused approach | Proton Pass |


## A few things I'd insist on

Whichever you choose, make sure it supports\:

- Individual employee accounts (no shared master login).
- Shared vaults with different access permissions.
- Two-factor authentication or passkeys.
- Immediate access revocation when someone leaves.
- Audit logs showing access and administrative changes.
- Secure sharing of API keys and other sensitive credentials.

## Let me narrow it down

Three details would help me make a more definitive recommendation.

**1\. How many people are on your team?**

---

**2\. What's your approximate budget per person?**

---

**3\. What's most important?**

[Get my recommendation]

I can then give you a clear winner rather than just another generic comparison.
